Coiled arm at face, elbow unfolds and BACK OF FIST strikes horizontally at head level, rotate shoulder, retract. Do not merge rows. All 16 poses whole feet visible. Absolutely no background.

Preserve his FACE, HAIR, body proportions, CLOTHES, footwear, colors and painting style exactly. Change fighting poses only. Genuine transparent background; no shadows, no ground, no text, no effects, no labels, no extra objects. Anatomically convincing force transfer: planted support foot, hips rotating, shoulders follow, guard protects face, impact limbs actually extend. Complete opaque full-body drawings, generous clear margins inside every cell, never overlap adjacent cells. Same character body scale throughout; same floor baseline within each row. Every pose faces RIGHT, slightly three-quarter side. No hats, martial arts uniforms, gloves, accessories or costume changes. Do not deform anatomy or invent missing arms/fingers.
Character: A sturdy man with black hair and full black beard, olive green polo shirt, dark blue jeans and BLACK trainers. Kung fu style: long low bow stance, lead OPEN palm and rear fist protecting face, straight centerline strikes and real front kicks. Do not use the old raised-knee-as-kick poses.
Exactly 16 full body poses in a 4 columns x 4 rows square atlas. Row-major order.
Row1: cells0,1 two breathing READY GUARD poses of this martial art, cell2 coiled guarded FOCUS CHARGE with weight low, cell3 powerful FOCUS STRIKE fully extended forward at chest height using palms for kung fu or a punch for boxing/kickboxing. Keep face and costume unchanged.
Row2: four HIGH HIT REACTION frames (receiving a punch): 4 immediate sharp face/head flinch, eyes squinted and chin recoils; 5 full backward stagger from head hit, shoulders rotate, front heel lifts slightly; 6 rear foot plants to absorb recoil and hands begin to cover face; 7 stance and guard recovering. Hands do NOT attack. Express realistic force reaction.
Row3: four BODY HIT REACTION frames: 8 immediate stomach crumple with face grimacing and bent knees; 9 abdomen compressed, upper torso recoils and hands instinctively lower; 10 back foot braces and torso unfolds; 11 recovering guard and balance. Keep standing.
Row4: four CROUCHED HIT REACTION frames: 12 flinch while crouching low; 13 low recoil and head turns back, hands cover face; 14 stabilizing feet and guard while still crouched; 15 crouched guard regaining balance. Stay low throughout. Full body fully visible in every cell.
